Michael Vargo is an urban planner, GIS specialist, and data researcher based in Columbus, Ohio. 

He received his Master of City and Regional Planning, along with his Bachelor of Arts in Arabic, French, and Political Science from The Ohio State University. He studied Modern Standard and Levantine Arabic at Middlebury Language Schools at the intermediate-advanced (3.5) level in the summer of 2022. 

Prior to planning, Michael worked as a high school English language instructor in rural eastern France. He also served as a teaching assistant for a mixed graduate and undergraduate course on transportation and land use during grad school. He greatly enjoys all elements of the teaching process, whether assisting with and leading instruction, designing coursework, or advising students.

### Personal

Michael is originally from [Columbiana, Ohio](https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/182685), where he grew up on a maple syrup and Christmas tree farm. A fan of the outdoors, he enjoys birding, biking, hiking, and bouldering, and can often be found biking along one of Central Ohio's many trails.

Michael also loves good espresso, making fun maps, and reading poetry and fiction in new languages (currently Portuguese). Floral button downs, German pop music, and reading the latest edition of The Economist bring him joy.
